sections.heading: Candle and diffuser gift set packaging: planning the fit
sections.text: Packaging applications Candle and diffuser gift set packaging: planning the fit For a candle and diffuser gift box, review the candle jar, bottle and reed length together before choosing outer dimensions. The illustrated candle and aromatherapy layout is a starting concept; a diffuser-and-reed version needs its own fitted sample. Packaging scope covers the box and agreed insert, not candles, oils or accessories. Multi-compartment candle gift boxes Keep glass items in separate cavities. Check the full jar diameter, lid height and packed weight; assess retention using the actual filled products rather than empty containers alone. Reed diffuser gift box inserts Account for the bottle closure and the complete reed bundle. A long reed compartment may change the box footprint. Review removal access and avoid loading the lid against fragile bottle components. Choose the insert and shipping pack together Compare EVA retention with paperboard dividers against the real product weight and presentation needs. A fitted display tray does not by itself prove parcel-shipping protection. Validate the complete box, transit carton and cushioning with the intended delivery method. sections.heading: Build the presentation around your product
sections.text: Customization Build the presentation around your product Logo & foil Review foil, print, emboss or deboss artwork against the chosen paper. Custom colour Use ivory, black, seasonal colours or a Pantone-matched wrapped paper. Fitted insert Set cavity count, product orientation and clearance from measured samples. Surface finish Compare matte, soft-touch, textured and other finish options at sampling.

sections.heading: What changes the quotation?
sections.text: Quote factors What changes the quotation? Finished dimensions, board and wrap grade, insert material, print coverage, finishing steps, quantity, packed carton dimensions, destination and Incoterms all affect the final scope. Ask for the same assumptions on every supplier quotation.

sections.heading: Buyer questions
sections.text: FAQ Buyer questions Which insert works for glass candles and bottles? EVA provides strong retention for many glass products; paperboard and molded pulp are alternatives when the product and sustainability requirements permit. Can the box hold several product types? Yes. The tray can use different cavity sizes for candles, bottles, soap and accessories after the product dimensions are confirmed. Can the outside match a botanical brand? Wrapped paper, custom colour, foil, embossing and textured finishes can be specified around the brand artwork. What should I send for sampling? Send product dimensions, packed weight, cavity count, artwork and destination so the structure and insert can be reviewed together.
